$comment: GIS-7401 gas-insulated switchgear bay twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the maker's ratings, the gas schematic and NIST SF6 data; the bay sends only what its IEDs measure.

identification.description: 132 kV cable feeder bay 4 of an indoor gas-insulated substation (one bay, four SF6 gas compartments)
identification.bay: Single busbar section, busbar disconnector DS1 + earthing switch ES1, circuit breaker CB with CTs, line disconnector DS2 + earthing switch ES2 + fast earthing switch FES, VT, cable sealing end
identification.monitoring: Gas density transmitters per compartment, UHF partial discharge sensors, breaker and switch monitoring in the bay controller (IEC 61850)

rating.source: Hitachi Energy, Gas-insulated switchgear ELK-04 C up to 145 kV, product page technical data

bb.name: Busbar disconnector + earthing switch (bay part of the busbar)

ld.name: Line disconnector + earthing switches + cable sealing end

compartments.source: Four gas compartments per bay, volumes, rated filling, alarm and minimum functional pressures (absolute, at 20 °C), gas heating at rated current: assumption: typical value, replace with your switchgear's gas schematic, routine test report and manual

sf6.source: Z(p,T) = 1 + p (a0 + a1/T + a2/T^2) + a3 p^2/T and p20 = rho R 293.15 (1 + q1 rho + q2 rho^2), least-squares fits of the NIST Chemistry WebBook SF6 isotherms listed in build_twin.py. GWP100 24 300 and the 500 t CO2e leakage-detection threshold: Regulation (EU) 2024/573.

tightness.source: IEC 62271-203:2022 reduced the type-test tightness requirement for gases with GWP > 1000 from 0.5 % to 0.1 % per year per gas compartment. The twin alerts at 0.5 %/year (the older class most installed bays were tested to).

breaker.wear_note: 20 interruptions of 40 kA with 15 ms of arcing
breaker.source: Spring mechanism, operating times, trip coil, charging time and I²t wear allowance: assumption: typical value, replace with your switchgear's gas schematic, routine test report and manual

switches.source: Disconnector and earthing switch motor-drive peak current and operating time from the routine test: assumption: typical value, replace with your switchgear's gas schematic, routine test report and manual

gas_quality.source: Moisture and SO2 action levels in service: assumption: typical value, replace with your switchgear's gas schematic, routine test report and manual (IEC 60480 gives the limits for re-use of recovered gas, not these)

pd.source: UHF sensor noise floor and the PD alarm (amplitude and pulse rate together), set at commissioning after the sensitivity check of IEC TS 62478: assumption: typical value, replace with your switchgear's gas schematic, routine test report and manual

instr.source: Two class 0.5 voltage transformers may differ by up to 1 %; protection and metering core of the same CT should agree within 2 % at load: assumption: typical value, replace with your switchgear's gas schematic, routine test report and manual

load.source: Daily load profile of the feeder and GIS hall temperature: assumption: typical value, replace with your switchgear's gas schematic, routine test report and manual

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 60 times faster, and the breaker and the switches are operated every 30 s of real time so their timings refresh; leak and wear figures come from the failure modes, not from the demo clock.

health_index.note: Each part = 100 - 60 x the worst indicator's distance to its limit (0 = normal value, 1 = at the limit, capped at 1.5). Bay = the weakest part.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

cb_compartment_leak.name: SF6 leak, circuit breaker compartment
cb_compartment_leak.symptoms: pressure at 20 °C falls, 30-day trend negative, leak rate above the tightness class, days to the alarm density shrink

density_sensor_drift.name: Gas density sensor drift, busbar compartment
density_sensor_drift.symptoms: reading above the filled density with a rising trend: physically impossible without a gas top-up, so the sensor drifts (and would hide a leak)

cb_slow_mechanism.name: Breaker mechanism slow (lubrication, latch)
cb_slow_mechanism.symptoms: opening time and trip coil armature time up, coil current and charging normal

cb_contact_wear.name: Arcing contact wear after fault interruptions
cb_contact_wear.symptoms: I²t sum near the allowance, SO2 from arcing rises in the CB compartment

ds_motor_wear.name: Disconnector drive stiff (gearbox, linkage)
ds_motor_wear.symptoms: DS1 motor peak current and operating time up

moisture_ingress.name: Moisture ingress, line disconnector compartment
moisture_ingress.symptoms: moisture ppmv rises in one compartment, density normal

internal_pd.name: Internal partial discharge (particle, floating electrode), busbar compartment
internal_pd.symptoms: UHF amplitude and pulse rate rise on one sensor only

vt_drift.name: Voltage transformer output drift
vt_drift.symptoms: bay VT reads away from the busbar VT with the disconnectors closed
